# Import fixtures

The four `.fbx` files are unmodified fixtures from
[ufbx/data](https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/main/data), under the included
`ufbx-LICENSE` (MIT or Unlicense). They cover ASCII, binary, partial skinning,
and skinned pivot transforms. No texture dependencies are needed.

`children.model.json` is generated by `cargo run --example build_fixture` through
the production RBXM child exporter. It exercises attachments, a bone hierarchy,
SurfaceAppearance content references, custom attributes and references to both a
sibling and the reconstructed MeshPart.
